title: All Threads Users Can Now DM Meta AI
excerpt: Meta AI is coming to Threads DMs, following availability inside Facebook, Instagram, and WhatsApp DMs.
content_html:
The feature is rolling out globally starting today. But you still can't block the AI's posts.

jackpress/Shutterstock

In May, Meta started testing Meta AI on Threads' public feed. Now, starting today, Meta is rolling out Meta AI to Threads users' DMs across the globe. The company claims the move is in response to community feedback from users who want more "context" from Meta without having to publicly share their conversations.

"The DM experience gives people greater flexibility in how and where they interact with Meta AI," Meta said in a statement. "People can share Threads posts, images, links or videos directly with Meta AI, ask follow-up questions and explore a topic in more depth within a one-on-one conversation." A similar feature is available across Meta's Facebook, Instagram, and WhatsApp.

At the same time, the company is still testing Meta AI's availability in Threads' public feeds. The feature was initially launched in just five countries: Argentina, Malaysia, Mexico, Saudi Arabia and Singapore. In those regions, you can both read and see Meta AI's own posts and tag it using @meta.ai. While you're still not able to block the account outright, you can click "not interested" and mute any Meta AI replies.

五月，Meta 开始在 Threads 的公共源上测试 Meta AI。 现在，从今天开始，Meta 正在向全球 Threads 用户的 DM 推出 Meta AI。 该公司声称此举是为了回应用户的社区反馈，这些用户希望从 Meta 获得更多“上下文”，而不必公开分享他们的对话。

与此同时，该公司仍在测试 Meta AI 在 Threads 公共源中的可用性。 该功能最初仅在五个国家推出：阿根廷、马来西亚、墨西哥、沙特阿拉伯和新加坡。 在这些地区，您可以阅读和查看 Meta AI 自己的帖子，并使用 @meta.ai 对其进行标记。 虽然您仍然无法完全阻止该帐户，但您可以单击“不感兴趣”并将任何 Meta AI 回复静音。
